records.literal_gloss: And crossed over Jehoram with his commanders, and all the chariots with him; and it was, he arose by night and struck Edom, the [one] surrounding him, and [the] commanders of the chariots.

en.L: And Jehoram crossed over with his commanders, and all the chariots with him. And it happened [that] he arose by night and struck Edom, which was surrounding him, and the commanders of the chariots.
en.B: So Jehoram crossed over with his commanders and all his chariots. He rose by night and attacked the Edomites who had surrounded him and the chariot commanders.
en.R: So Jehoram marched out with his commanders and all his chariots. The Edomites surrounded him, but he got up during the night and attacked them and the chariot commanders.

es.L: Y Jehoram pasó con sus jefes, y todos los carros con él. Y sucedió [que] se levantó de noche e hirió a Edom, que lo tenía rodeado, y a los jefes de los carros.
es.B: Entonces Jehoram pasó con sus jefes y todos sus carros. Se levantó de noche y atacó a los edomitas que lo tenían rodeado y a los jefes de los carros.
es.R: Entonces Jehoram salió con sus jefes y todos sus carros. Los edomitas lo rodearon, pero él se levantó durante la noche y los atacó a ellos y a los jefes de los carros.

fr.L: Et Yehoram passa avec ses chefs, et tous les chars avec lui. Et il arriva qu’il se leva de nuit et frappa Édom, qui l’encerclait, et les chefs des chars.
fr.B: Yehoram passa donc avec ses chefs et tous ses chars. Il se leva de nuit et attaqua les Édomites qui l’avaient encerclé, ainsi que les chefs des chars.
fr.R: Alors Yehoram est parti en campagne avec ses chefs et tous ses chars. Les Édomites l’ont encerclé, mais il s’est levé pendant la nuit et il les a attaqués, eux et les chefs des chars.

sw.L: Yehoramu akavuka pamoja na makamanda wake, na magari yote ya vita pamoja naye. Ikawa akainuka usiku, akawapiga Edomu waliokuwa wamemzunguka, na wakuu wa magari ya vita.
sw.B: Basi Yehoramu akavuka pamoja na makamanda wake na magari yake yote ya vita. Akainuka usiku, akawashambulia Waedomu waliokuwa wamemzunguka pamoja na wakuu wa magari ya vita.
sw.R: Basi Yehoramu akaondoka pamoja na makamanda wake na magari yake yote ya vita. Waedomu walimzunguka, lakini akainuka usiku, akawashambulia wao pamoja na wakuu wa magari ya vita.

vi.L: Giê-hô-ram đi qua cùng các tướng của mình và tất cả các xe chiến mã. Ban đêm vua đứng dậy đánh quân Ê-đôm đang vây quanh mình và các chỉ huy xe chiến mã.
vi.B: Vậy Giê-hô-ram kéo quân qua cùng các tướng và tất cả xe chiến mã. Ban đêm vua đứng dậy tấn công quân Ê-đôm đang vây quanh mình cùng các chỉ huy xe chiến mã.
vi.R: Vậy Giê-hô-ram đem các tướng và tất cả xe chiến mã kéo ra. Quân Ê-đôm vây quanh vua, nhưng ban đêm vua đứng dậy tấn công họ và các chỉ huy xe chiến mã.

ko.L: 그리고 여호람이 그의 지휘관들과 함께, 모든 병거와 함께 건너갔다. 그리고 그가 밤에 일어나 자기를 에워싸고 있던 에돔과 병거대 지휘관들을 쳤다.
ko.B: 그래서 여호람은 지휘관들과 모든 병거를 거느리고 건너갔다. 그는 밤에 일어나 자기를 에워싼 에돔 사람들과 병거대 지휘관들을 쳤다.
ko.R: 그래서 여호람은 지휘관들과 병거를 모두 이끌고 나갔다. 에돔 사람들이 그를 에워쌌지만, 그는 밤에 일어나 그들과 병거대 지휘관들을 공격했다.

pt.L: E Jorão passou com os seus chefes, e todos os carros com ele. E aconteceu [que] ele se levantou de noite e feriu Edom, que o cercava, e os chefes dos carros.
pt.B: Então Jorão partiu com os seus comandantes e todos os seus carros. Ele se levantou de noite e atacou os edomitas que o tinham cercado, e também os comandantes dos carros.
pt.R: Então Jorão saiu com os seus comandantes e todos os seus carros de guerra. Os edomitas o cercaram, mas ele se levantou durante a noite e atacou os edomitas e os comandantes dos carros.

am.L: ኢዮራምም ሰረገሎቹ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ሆነው ከአለቆቹ ጋር ተሻገረ፤ እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በሌሊት ተነሥቶ የከበበውን ኤዶምንና የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች መታ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ኢዮራም ከአለቆቹ ጋር ሰረገሎቹን ሁሉ ይዞ ተሻገረ። በሌሊትም ተነሥቶ የከበቡትን ኤዶማውያንና የሰረገሎቻቸውን አለቆች መታ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ኢዮራም ከአለቆቹ ጋር ሰረገሎቹን ሁሉ ይዞ ዘመተ። ኤዶማውያን ከበቡት፤ እርሱ ግን በሌሊት ተነሥቶ እነርሱንና የሰረገሎቻቸውን አለቆች መታ።

hi.L: और यहोराम अपने प्रधानों के साथ, और सब रथ उसके साथ, पार गया। और ऐसा हुआ [कि] उसने रात को उठकर एदोम को, जो उसे घेरे हुए था, और रथों के प्रधानों को मारा।
hi.B: तब यहोराम अपने प्रधानों और अपने सब रथों के साथ पार गया। उसने रात को उठकर उन एदोमियों पर, जिन्होंने उसे घेर रखा था, और रथों के प्रधानों पर हमला किया।
hi.R: तब यहोराम अपने प्रधानों और अपने सब रथों के साथ निकला। एदोमियों ने उसे घेर लिया, पर उसने रात को उठकर उन पर और रथों के प्रधानों पर हमला किया।

ru.L: И перешёл Иорам со своими начальниками, и все колесницы с ним. И было, встал он ночью и поразил Едом, окружавший его, и начальников колесниц.
ru.B: И Иорам переправился со своими начальниками и со всеми своими колесницами. Ночью он поднялся и напал на едомитян, окруживших его, и на начальников колесниц.
ru.R: Тогда Иорам выступил в поход со своими начальниками и со всеми своими колесницами. Едомитяне окружили его, но ночью он поднялся и напал на них и на начальников их колесниц.

uk.L: І перейшов Єгорам зі своїми начальниками, і всі колісниці з ним. І сталося, [що] він устав уночі і розбив Едом, що оточував його, і начальників колісниць.
uk.B: Тож Єгорам переправився зі своїми начальниками і всіма своїми колісницями. Він устав уночі і напав на едомітян, що оточили його, і на начальників колісниць.
uk.R: Тож Єгорам вирушив зі своїми начальниками і всіма своїми колісницями. Едомітяни оточили його, але він устав уночі і напав на них і на начальників колісниць.

decisions.choice: with his commanders, where 2 Kings 8:21 has "to Zair"
decisions.reason: Kings says Joram crossed over "to Zair"; Chronicles says Jehoram crossed over "with his commanders". The two phrases look alike in Hebrew writing, so one may have come from the other in copying. Chronicles also leaves out the end of 2 Kings 8:21, "and the people fled to their tents", and calls the king Jehoram where Kings has Joram.

decisions.choice: he struck Edom who surrounded him: Jehoram broke out of an encirclement
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 8:21, the sense seems to be that the Edomites had surrounded Jehoram's force and that he broke out by night, striking them and their chariot commanders. Verse 10 shows that the campaign still failed: Edom stayed free.

decisions.choice: commanders: Judah's officers in verse 9a, Edom's in 9b
decisions.reason: The same word is used twice: first for Jehoram's own commanders, then for the commanders of the chariots he attacked, who belonged to Edom.

decisions.choice: marched out
decisions.reason: Readable says "marched out" for "crossed over", since Chronicles does not name the place he crossed to, and gives the Edomite attack first so the order of events is clear.

decisions.choice: "salió"
decisions.reason: Readable says "salió" for "crossed over", since Chronicles names no place he crossed to, as the English says "marched out"; Literal and Balanced keep "pasó" of Spanish 2 Kings 8:21.

decisions.choice: "avec ses chefs" where French 2 Kings 8:21 has "à Tsaïr"; the rest kept
decisions.reason: The Hebrew differs only in those words and in leaving out the flight of the people.

decisions.choice: The wording of 2 Kings 8:21, with "그의 지휘관들과 함께" in place of "사일로" and no flight of the troops
decisions.reason: Chronicles reads "with his commanders" where Kings has "to Zair" and leaves out the last clause (m1); the rest keeps the Kings wording.

decisions.choice: com os seus chefes (L) / comandantes (B, R) in place of "a Zair"; no closing clause
decisions.reason: As 2 Kings 8:21 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' differences (m1): "com os seus chefes" where Kings has "a Zair", and without Kings' last clause about the people fleeing. The same word serves both groups of officers (m3), "chefes" at Literal and "comandantes" at Balanced and Readable, as in Kings.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 8:21 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; Chronicles has "with his commanders" ("ከአለቆቹ ጋር") where Kings has "to Zair" ("ወደ ጻዒር"), and it lacks Kings' closing "and the people fled to their tents".
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.

decisions.choice: "अपने प्रधानों के साथ"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "with his commanders" where 2 Kings 8:21 has "to Zair", and no flight of the people (meaning m1); the rest keeps the Kings wording.

source.text: וַיִּפְשַׁ֨ע אֱד֜וֹם מִתַּ֣חַת יַד־יְהוּדָ֗ה עַ֚ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אָ֣ז תִּפְשַׁ֥ע לִבְנָ֛ה בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖יא מִתַּ֣חַת יָד֑וֹ כִּ֣י עָזַ֔ב אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And rebelled Edom from under [the] hand of Judah until the day the this; then rebelled Libnah at the time the that from under his hand, for he had forsaken Yahweh [the] God of his fathers.

en.L: And Edom has rebelled from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah rebelled at that time from under his hand, because he had forsaken {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of his fathers.
en.B: So Edom has been in rebellion against the rule of Judah to this day. Libnah also rebelled against his rule at that same time, because he had forsaken {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of his ancestors.
en.R: So Edom has stayed free from Judah's rule to this day. At the same time the town of Libnah also rebelled against Jehoram's rule. This happened because he had turned away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of his ancestors.

es.L: Y se rebeló Edom de debajo de la mano de Judá hasta el día de hoy. Entonces se rebeló Libna en aquel tiempo de debajo de su mano, porque él había abandonado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus padres.
es.B: Así Edom ha estado en rebelión contra el dominio de Judá hasta el día de hoy. En ese mismo tiempo se rebeló también Libna contra su dominio, porque él había abandonado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados.
es.R: Así Edom ha seguido libre del dominio de Judá hasta el día de hoy. En ese mismo tiempo se rebeló también la ciudad de Libna contra el dominio de Jehoram. Esto sucedió porque él se había apartado {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et Édom s’est révolté de dessous la main de Juda jusqu’à ce jour. Alors Libna se révolta en ce temps-là de dessous sa main, parce qu’il avait abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de ses pères.
fr.B: Ainsi Édom est resté en révolte contre la domination de Juda jusqu’à aujourd’hui. Libna aussi se révolta contre sa domination à la même époque, parce qu’il avait abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de ses ancêtres.
fr.R: Ainsi, Édom est resté libre de l’autorité de Juda jusqu’à aujourd’hui. À la même époque, la ville de Libna s’est aussi révoltée contre l’autorité de Yehoram. C’est arrivé parce qu’il s’était détourné {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu de ses ancêtres.

sw.L: Edomu wameasi kutoka chini ya mkono wa Yuda mpaka siku hii ya leo. Ndipo Libna nao wakaasi wakati ule ule kutoka chini ya mkono wake, kwa sababu alikuwa amemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa baba zake.
sw.B: Basi Edomu wamekuwa katika uasi dhidi ya utawala wa Yuda mpaka leo. Libna nao waliasi dhidi ya utawala wake wakati huo huo, kwa sababu alikuwa amemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zake.
sw.R: Basi Edomu wameendelea kuwa huru kutoka utawala wa Yuda mpaka leo. Wakati huo huo mji wa Libna nao ukaasi dhidi ya utawala wa Yehoramu. Haya yalitokea kwa sababu alikuwa amemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zake.

vi.L: Ê-đôm đã nổi loạn thoát khỏi tay Giu-đa cho đến ngày nay. Bấy giờ Líp-na cũng nổi loạn vào lúc ấy, thoát khỏi tay vua, vì vua đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ mình.
vi.B: Vậy Ê-đôm đã chống lại sự cai trị của Giu-đa cho đến ngày nay. Cũng vào lúc ấy, Líp-na nổi loạn chống lại sự cai trị của vua, vì vua đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên mình.
vi.R: Vậy Ê-đôm vẫn thoát khỏi sự cai trị của Giu-đa cho đến ngày nay. Cũng vào lúc ấy, thành Líp-na nổi loạn chống lại Giê-hô-ram. Việc này xảy ra vì vua đã từ bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên mình.

ko.L: 그리고 에돔이 오늘날까지 유다의 손 아래에서 반역하고 있다. 그때에 립나도 그의 손 아래에서 반역했다. 그가 그의 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버렸기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그래서 에돔은 오늘날까지 유다의 통치에 반기를 든 채로 있다. 그때에 립나도 그의 통치에 반기를 들었다. 그가 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버렸기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그래서 에돔은 오늘날까지 유다의 다스림을 받지 않고 있다. 그때에 립나 성읍도 여호람의 다스림에 맞서 반역했다. 이런 일이 일어난 것은 여호람이 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게서 돌아섰기 때문이다.

pt.L: E Edom se rebelou de debaixo da mão de Judá até este dia. Então Libna se rebelou naquele tempo de debaixo da mão dele, porque ele tinha abandonado {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus pais.
pt.B: Assim Edom tem estado em rebelião contra o domínio de Judá até o dia de hoje. Libna também se rebelou contra o domínio dele naquela mesma época, porque ele tinha abandonado {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados.
pt.R: Assim Edom continua livre do domínio de Judá até o dia de hoje. Na mesma época, a cidade de Libna também se rebelou contra o domínio de Jorão. Isso aconteceu porque ele tinha se afastado {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados.

am.L: ኤዶምም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከይሁዳ እጅ በታች ዐምፆአል። በዚያን ጊዜም ልብና ከእጁ በታች ዐመፀች፤ የአባቶቹን አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ትቶ ነበርና።
am.B: ስለዚህ ኤዶም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በይሁዳ አገዛዝ ላይ እንዳመፀ ነው። በዚያው ጊዜ ልብናም ደግሞ በአገዛዙ ላይ ዐመፀች፤ የአባቶቹን አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ትቶ ነበርና።
am.R: ስለዚህ ኤዶም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከይሁዳ አገዛዝ ነፃ ሆኖ ቆይቷል። በዚያው ጊዜ ልብና የምትባለው ከተማም በኢዮራም አገዛዝ ላይ ዐመፀች። ይህ የሆነው ኢዮራም የአባቶቹን አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ስለ ተወ ነው።

hi.L: और एदोम आज के दिन तक यहूदा के हाथ के नीचे से विद्रोह किए हुए है। तब उसी समय लिब्ना ने भी उसके हाथ के नीचे से विद्रोह किया, क्योंकि उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर को त्याग दिया था।
hi.B: इस तरह एदोम आज तक यहूदा के शासन से विद्रोह किए हुए है। उसी समय लिब्ना ने भी उसके शासन से विद्रोह किया, क्योंकि उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर को, त्याग दिया था।
hi.R: इस तरह एदोम आज तक यहूदा के शासन से आज़ाद है। उसी समय लिब्ना नगर ने भी यहोराम के शासन से बग़ावत कर दी। यह इसलिए हुआ कि उसने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने पूर्वजों के परमेश्वर से मुँह मोड़ लिया था।

ru.L: И отложился Едом из-под руки Иуды до сего дня. Тогда же восстала Ливна в то время из-под его руки, потому что он оставил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Бога своих отцов.
ru.B: Так Едом вышел из-под власти Иуды и остаётся непокорным до сего дня. В то же время восстала против его власти и Ливна, потому что он оставил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Бога своих предков.
ru.R: И с тех пор Едом не подчиняется Иуде до сих пор. В то же время восстал против власти Иорама и город Ливна. Это случилось потому, что Иорам отвернулся от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Бога своих предков.

uk.L: І Едом відпав з-під руки Юди до цього дня. Тоді того часу відпала з-під його руки Лівна, бо він покинув {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, Бога своїх батьків.
uk.B: Так Едом перебуває в повстанні проти влади Юди до цього дня. Того самого часу Лівна також повстала проти його влади, бо він покинув {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, Бога своїх предків.
uk.R: Тож Едом залишається вільним від влади Юди до цього дня. Того самого часу місто Лівна також повстало проти Єгорамової влади. Це сталося тому, що він відвернувся від {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, Бога своїх предків.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 8:22 with a reason added
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 2 Kings 8:22 and adds two things: Libnah rebelled "from under his hand", and it happened "because he had forsaken Yahweh the God of his fathers". Chronicles often names the reason for a king's losses (12:2; 24:24).

decisions.choice: because he had forsaken Yahweh: the reason for both revolts
alternatives: the reason for Libnah's revolt only
decisions.reason: The reason stands after Libnah's revolt, but it explains Jehoram's losses as a whole, Edom's revolt as well as Libnah's.

decisions.choice: to this day: the writer's own day
decisions.reason: As at 5:9, "to this day" means the time when the account was written, here repeated from 2 Kings 8:22.

decisions.choice: Libnah: a town in the lowland of Judah
decisions.reason: Libnah lay in the low hills west of Judah, near the Philistine border, and was a town of the priests (Joshua 21:13; 1 Chronicles 6:42). Its revolt shows Judah losing ground on the west as well as in Edom.

decisions.choice: has been in rebellion (Balanced); has stayed free (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 8:22: "to this day" makes the revolt a lasting state. Balanced says "ancestors" for "fathers".

decisions.choice: turned away from
decisions.reason: Readable says "turned away from" for "forsaken", a less common word, and gives the reason its own sentence.

decisions.choice: as 2 Kings 8:22, adding "de debaixo da mão dele" (L) / "contra o domínio dele" (B) and the reason; abandonado (L, B), se afastado (R)
decisions.reason: The Portuguese of 2 Kings 8:22 at each level, with the two things Chronicles adds (m1). "Abandonar" is the usual Old Testament verb for forsaking the LORD; Readable says "se afastado", as the English "turned away from".

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 8:22 is kept where the Hebrew is the same; Chronicles adds "from under his hand" ("ከእጁ በታች", Balanced "በአገዛዙ ላይ") to Libnah's revolt and the reason "because he had forsaken the LORD the God of his fathers".
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.

source.text: גַּם־ה֥וּא עָשָֽׂה־בָמ֖וֹת בְּהָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֶּ֨זֶן֙ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיַּדַּ֖ח אֶת־יְהוּדָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Also he made high places in [the] mountains of Judah, and he made prostitute [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem, and he drove astray Judah.

en.L: He also made high places in the mountains of Judah, and he caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, and he drove Judah astray.
en.B: He also made high places in the hill country of Judah. He caused the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves and led Judah astray.
en.R: He also built hilltop shrines in the hill country of Judah. He led the people of Jerusalem to be unfaithful to God, like a wife who sleeps with other men, and he made Judah turn away from God.

es.L: También hizo lugares altos en los montes de Judá, e hizo prostituirse a los habitantes de Jerusalén, y descarrió a Judá.
es.B: También hizo lugares altos en la región montañosa de Judá. Hizo que los habitantes de Jerusalén se prostituyeran y llevó a Judá por mal camino.
es.R: También construyó santuarios sobre las colinas en la región montañosa de Judá. Llevó a la gente de Jerusalén a ser infiel a Dios, como una esposa que se acuesta con otros hombres, e hizo que Judá se apartara de Dios.

fr.L: Il fit aussi des hauts lieux dans les montagnes de Juda, et il fit se prostituer les habitants de Jérusalem, et il égara Juda.
fr.B: Il établit aussi des hauts lieux dans la région montagneuse de Juda. Il poussa les habitants de Jérusalem à se prostituer et il égara Juda.
fr.R: Il a aussi construit des sanctuaires sur les collines, dans la région montagneuse de Juda. Il a poussé les habitants de Jérusalem à être infidèles à Dieu, comme une femme qui couche avec d’autres hommes, et il a détourné Juda de Dieu.

sw.L: Pia alifanya mahali pa juu katika milima ya Yuda, akawafanya wakaaji wa Yerusalemu wafanye ukahaba, akaipotosha Yuda.
sw.B: Pia alijenga mahali pa juu katika nchi ya milima ya Yuda. Akawafanya watu wa Yerusalemu wafanye ukahaba, akaipotosha Yuda.
sw.R: Pia alijenga patakatifu pa kilimani katika nchi ya milima ya Yuda. Aliwaongoza watu wa Yerusalemu wasiwe waaminifu kwa Mungu, kama mke anayelala na wanaume wengine, naye akawafanya watu wa Yuda wamwache Mungu.

vi.L: Vua cũng lập các nơi cao trên các núi Giu-đa, và khiến dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem làm điều dâm loạn, và xô đẩy Giu-đa đi lạc.
vi.B: Vua cũng lập các nơi cao trong vùng đồi núi Giu-đa. Vua khiến dân Giê-ru-sa-lem làm điều dâm loạn và dẫn Giu-đa đi lạc.
vi.R: Vua cũng xây những nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao trong vùng đồi núi Giu-đa. Vua khiến dân Giê-ru-sa-lem bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời, như người vợ ăn nằm với đàn ông khác, và vua làm cho Giu-đa lìa bỏ Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 또 그가 유다의 산들에 산당들을 만들고, 예루살렘 주민들이 음행하게 하고, 유다를 꾀어 내몰았다.
ko.B: 그는 또 유다의 산지에 산당들을 만들었다. 그는 예루살렘 주민들이 음행하게 하고, 유다를 그릇된 길로 이끌었다.
ko.R: 그는 또 유다의 산지에 산꼭대기 제단들을 만들었다. 그는 예루살렘 사람들이 하나님께 불성실하게 했다. 남편을 두고 다른 남자와 자는 아내처럼 되게 한 것이다. 그리고 유다가 하나님에게서 돌아서게 했다.

pt.L: Também ele fez altos nos montes de Judá, e fez os habitantes de Jerusalém se prostituírem, e desviou Judá.
pt.B: Ele também fez altos na região montanhosa de Judá. Levou os moradores de Jerusalém a se prostituírem e desencaminhou Judá.
pt.R: Ele também construiu santuários no alto dos morros na região montanhosa de Judá. Levou o povo de Jerusalém a ser infiel a Deus, como uma esposa que dorme com outros homens, e fez Judá se afastar de Deus.

am.L: እርሱም ደግሞ በይሁዳ ተራሮች የኮረብታ መስገጃዎችን ሠራ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ነዋሪዎች እንዲያመነዝሩ አደረገ፤ ይሁዳንም ገፋፍቶ አሳተ።
am.B: በይሁዳ ኮረብታማ አገርም የኮረብታ መስገጃዎችን ሠራ። የኢየሩሳሌምን ሕዝብ እንዲያመነዝሩ አደረገ፤ ይሁዳንም አሳተ።
am.R: በይሁዳ ኮረብታማ አገር ደግሞ በኮረብታ ላይ የአምልኮ ስፍራዎችን ሠራ። የኢየሩሳሌምን ሕዝብ ለእግዚአብሔር ታማኝ እንዳይሆኑ አደረገ፤ ይህም ሚስት ከሌሎች ወንዶች ጋር እንደምትተኛ ያለ ክህደት ነበረ። ይሁዳንም ከእግዚአብሔር እንዲርቅ አደረገ።

hi.L: उसने भी यहूदा के पहाड़ों पर ऊँचे स्थान बनाए, और यरूशलेम के निवासियों से व्यभिचार करवाया, और यहूदा को भटका दिया।
hi.B: उसने यहूदा के पहाड़ी देश में ऊँचे स्थान भी बनाए। उसने यरूशलेम के लोगों से व्यभिचार करवाया और यहूदा को भटका दिया।
hi.R: उसने यहूदा के पहाड़ी देश में ऊँचे स्थान भी बनवाए। उसने यरूशलेम के लोगों को परमेश्वर से विश्वासघात करने में लगाया, जैसे कोई पत्नी पराए पुरुषों के साथ सोती है, और उसने यहूदा को परमेश्वर से दूर कर दिया।

ru.L: Также он сделал высоты на горах Иуды, и ввёл в блуд жителей Иерусалима, и совратил Иуду.
ru.B: Он также устроил святилища на холмах в горах Иуды, вовлёк жителей Иерусалима в блуд и сбил Иуду с пути.
ru.R: Он также построил святилища на холмах в горной стране Иуды. Он сделал так, что жители Иерусалима стали неверны Богу, как жена, которая уходит от мужа к другим мужчинам, и отвратил Иуду от Бога.

decisions.choice: high places: local shrines
decisions.reason: High places were places of worship, often on hills, outside the temple in Jerusalem. Jehoshaphat had removed them (17:6); his son set them up again. Verses 11-20 have no parallel in Kings.

decisions.choice: caused them to prostitute themselves: led them to worship other gods
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the language of prostitution for Israel's unfaithfulness to Yahweh, who is pictured as her husband (Exodus 34:15-16; Deuteronomy 31:16; Hosea 1:2). The worship at the high places, after Ahab's example (verse 13), broke faith with him.

decisions.choice: drove astray: pushed away from Yahweh
decisions.reason: The verb means to push or drive someone away, here from the right way, as in Deuteronomy 13:6, 11, where it is used of those who lead others to serve other gods.

decisions.choice: in the mountains of Judah
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek and Latin translations read "in the cities of Judah"; the two words differ by one letter in Hebrew. The meaning is close: shrines throughout Judah.

decisions.choice: high places / high places / hilltop shrines
decisions.reason: As set for these books for bamot.

decisions.choice: to be unfaithful to God, like a wife who sleeps with other men; turn away from God
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of prostitution as unfaithfulness in a marriage (m2) and names God as the one Judah left.

decisions.choice: "a ser infiel a Dios, como una esposa que se acuesta con otros hombres"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of prostitution as unfaithfulness in marriage, as the English Readable does (m2).

decisions.choice: "làm điều dâm loạn"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture of unfaithfulness (m2); Readable explains it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "음행하게 하다"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture of prostitution for unfaithfulness to God (m2); Readable explains it as an unfaithful wife, as the English does.

decisions.choice: os altos (L, B), santuários no alto dos morros (R); se prostituírem (L, B); ser infiel a Deus, como uma esposa que dorme com outros homens (R)
decisions.reason: The high places keep the wording 1:3 sets for the book (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the picture of prostitution for unfaithfulness to God (m2), as the English does; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does. The same words return in verse 13.

decisions.choice: "caused to prostitute themselves" is "እንዲያመነዝሩ አደረገ" (Literal, Balanced), as "አመነዘሩ" in Judges 8:33; high places "የኮረብታ መስገጃዎች" (Readable "በኮረብታ ላይ የአምልኮ ስፍራዎች", as 2 Kings).
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures unfaithfulness to Yahweh as adultery; "ማመንዘር" keeps that picture, and Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "व्यभिचार करवाया" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The prophets' picture of worshipping other gods as prostitution (meaning m2); Literal and Balanced keep it, Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ввёл в блуд" (L); "вовлёк в блуд" (B); a comparison with an unfaithful wife (R)
decisions.reason: The same picture as Judges 2:17 in this translation: the prostitution is the worship of other gods; Readable explains it as Judges 2:17 does.

am.R: ከዚያም ከነቢዩ ከኤልያስ ለኢዮራም ደብዳቤ መጣለት። እንዲህ ይል ነበር፦ «የቅድመ አያትህ የዳዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ አንተ አባትህ ኢዮሣፍጥ እንደ ኖረ ወይም የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አሳ እንደ ኖረ አልኖርህም።

decisions.choice: a letter from Elijah the prophet
decisions.reason: The word means a written document. This is the only time Elijah is named in Chronicles and the only written message of his in Scripture. It brings Yahweh's word in the prophet's usual form, "Thus says Yahweh".

decisions.choice: when the letter came: Elijah's place in the time of Jehoram
alternatives: Elijah was still alive in Jehoram's early years
Elijah wrote the letter before he was taken up, to be delivered later
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 2 tells of Elijah's being taken up before the events of 2 Kings 3, which are set while Jehoshaphat was still alive (2 Kings 3:7, 11). So Elijah may have been gone before Jehoram became king. But the accounts of Kings are not always told in time order, and Jehoram reigned for a time beside his father (2 Kings 1:17; 8:16), so Elijah may still have been alive early in his reign. Others suggest that Elijah wrote the letter before he was taken up, for it to be delivered later. The text does not say.

decisions.choice: David your father: your ancestor David
decisions.reason: "Father" here means forefather. Jehoshaphat, named next, is his father in the ordinary sense.

decisions.choice: the ways of Jehoshaphat and Asa: the faithful kings before him
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat and Asa are judged in Chronicles as kings who sought Yahweh (14:1; 17:3-4), though not without fault. Jehoram broke with their example.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD / The LORD ... says this / This is what the LORD ... says
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula as worded at each level in these books.

decisions.choice: a statement in its own sentence
decisions.reason: Readable drops "because" and makes the charge a sentence of its own; verse 14 then gives the result with "So".

decisions.choice: "un escrito" (L); "una carta" (B, R); "el profeta Elías"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the general word for a writing; Balanced and Readable say "carta", as the English says "letter". Elías as the terms note.

decisions.choice: "tu" from the prophet to the king
decisions.reason: As in Samuel and Kings, prophets address the king with "tu".

decisions.choice: waraka (L, B); barua (R)
decisions.reason: "Waraka" is the word for a formal written letter; Readable uses the everyday "barua".

decisions.choice: God speaks to the king as "ngươi" at every level
decisions.reason: In a word of judgment God says "ngươi" to a king, as in the 1 Kings drafts; "vua" is how a prophet speaks in his own name.

decisions.choice: Elijah's letter in 해라체 ("말씀하신다", "너"), with Yahweh's words inside single quotation marks
alternatives: 합쇼체, as prophets usually speak to kings
decisions.reason: A written judgment from the prophet who spoke plainly to Ahab; the Kings drafts give Elijah plain speech toward the house of Ahab (uncertain). The quotation marks follow the Korean usage of Kings for an oracle inside a prophet's words.

decisions.choice: tu (the LORD's words in Elijah's letter, verses 12-15); Elias, o profeta; uma carta
decisions.reason: The letter gives the LORD's own word in the messenger formula (m1), so the king is addressed with "tu", as the LORD speaks to Ahab through Elijah in 1 Kings 21:19-21 in Portuguese; a prophet's own words to a king say "você" (19:2; 20:37). "Assim diz o SENHOR" (L, B) and "É isto que o SENHOR diz" (R), as in Kings. "Davi, teu pai" (L) keeps the Hebrew "father", and Balanced and Readable say "antepassado" (m3).

decisions.choice: Elijah's letter says "አንተ" to the king; "letter" is "ደብዳቤ".
alternatives: "መጽሐፍ" (the older word for a written message)
decisions.reason: A prophet bringing God's word to a king says "አንተ", as the Kings terms list rules. "ደብዳቤ" is the terms list's word for a letter sent and read.

decisions.choice: "David your father" is "የቅድመ አያትህ የዳዊት" (Balanced, Readable), as in 2 Kings 20:5.
decisions.reason: David lived many generations before Jehoram; Literal keeps the Hebrew "father".

decisions.choice: "तुम" in the letter
decisions.reason: The letter gives the LORD's own words to the king ("Thus says the LORD"), and God speaking to people says तुम, as in Elijah's message to Ahab in 1 Kings 21:19.

source.text: וַתֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדֶ֨רֶךְ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַתַּזְנֶ֤ה אֶת־יְהוּדָה֙ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּהַזְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וְגַ֨ם אֶת־אַחֶ֧יךָ בֵית־אָבִ֛יךָ הַטּוֹבִ֥ים מִמְּךָ֖ הָרָֽגְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: and you have walked in [the] way of [the] kings of Israel, and made prostitute Judah and [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem like [the] prostituting of [the] house of Ahab, and also your brothers, [the] house of your father, the good [ones] more than you, you have killed,

en.L: but you have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have caused Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, like the prostituting of the house of Ahab, and you have also killed your brothers, your father's house, who were better than you,
en.B: but have followed the way of the kings of Israel, and have led Judah and the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, as the house of Ahab did, and have also killed your brothers, your own father's family, men better than you,
en.R: Instead, you have lived the way the kings of Israel lived. You have led Judah and the people of Jerusalem to be unfaithful to God, just as Ahab's family led Israel to be unfaithful. You have even killed your own brothers, your father's sons, who were better men than you.

es.L: sino que has andado en el camino de los reyes de Israel, y has hecho prostituirse a Judá y a los habitantes de Jerusalén, como se prostituyó la casa de Acab, y también has matado a tus hermanos, la casa de tu padre, que eran mejores que tú,
es.B: sino que has seguido el camino de los reyes de Israel, y has llevado a Judá y a los habitantes de Jerusalén a prostituirse, como lo hizo la casa de Acab, y además has matado a tus hermanos, la familia de tu propio padre, hombres mejores que tú,
es.R: En cambio, has vivido como vivieron los reyes de Israel. Has llevado a la gente de Judá y de Jerusalén a ser infiel a Dios, como la familia de Acab llevó a Israel a ser infiel. Hasta has matado a tus propios hermanos, los hijos de tu padre, que eran mejores que tú.

fr.L: mais tu as marché dans la voie des rois d’Israël, et tu as fait se prostituer Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem, comme la maison d’Achab s’est prostituée, et tu as aussi tué tes frères, la maison de ton père, qui étaient meilleurs que toi,
fr.B: mais tu as suivi la voie des rois d’Israël, tu as poussé Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem à se prostituer, comme l’a fait la maison d’Achab, et tu as même tué tes frères, la famille de ton propre père, des hommes meilleurs que toi,
fr.R: Au contraire, tu as vécu comme les rois d’Israël. Tu as poussé Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem à être infidèles à Dieu, comme la famille d’Achab a poussé Israël à être infidèle. Tu as même tué tes propres frères, les fils de ton père, qui valaient mieux que toi.

sw.L: bali umekwenda katika njia ya wafalme wa Israeli, na umewafanya Yuda na wakaaji wa Yerusalemu wafanye ukahaba, kama ukahaba wa nyumba ya Ahabu, na pia umewaua ndugu zako, nyumba ya baba yako, waliokuwa bora kuliko wewe,
sw.B: bali umefuata njia ya wafalme wa Israeli, ukawafanya Yuda na watu wa Yerusalemu wafanye ukahaba, kama nyumba ya Ahabu ilivyofanya, tena umewaua ndugu zako, jamaa ya baba yako mwenyewe, watu waliokuwa bora kuliko wewe,
sw.R: Badala yake, umeishi kama wafalme wa Israeli walivyoishi. Umewaongoza watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu wasiwe waaminifu kwa Mungu, kama jamaa ya Ahabu ilivyowaongoza Israeli wasiwe waaminifu. Hata umewaua ndugu zako mwenyewe, wana wa baba yako, waliokuwa watu bora kuliko wewe.

vi.L: nhưng ngươi đã đi trong đường lối của các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, và khiến Giu-đa cùng dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem làm điều dâm loạn, như sự dâm loạn của nhà A-háp; ngươi cũng đã giết các anh em ngươi, là nhà cha ngươi, những người tốt hơn ngươi,
vi.B: mà lại theo đường lối của các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, khiến Giu-đa và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem làm điều dâm loạn như nhà A-háp đã làm; ngươi cũng đã giết các em ngươi, chính gia đình cha ngươi, là những người tốt hơn ngươi,
vi.R: Trái lại, ngươi đã sống như các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ngươi đã khiến Giu-đa và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem bất trung với Đức Chúa Trời, giống như gia đình A-háp đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên bất trung. Ngươi còn giết các em trai ruột của mình, là các con trai của cha ngươi, những người tốt hơn ngươi.

ko.L: 이스라엘 왕들의 길로 걸었고, 아합의 집이 음행한 것처럼 유다와 예루살렘 주민들이 음행하게 했으며, 또 너보다 나은 너의 형제들, 곧 너의 아버지의 집을 죽였으니,
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕들의 길을 따라갔고, 아합의 집안이 한 것처럼 유다와 예루살렘 주민들이 음행하게 했으며, 너보다 나은 사람들인 너의 형제들, 곧 너의 아버지의 집안 사람들까지 죽였다.
ko.R: 오히려 너는 이스라엘 왕들이 살던 대로 살았다. 너는 아합의 집안이 이스라엘을 하나님께 불성실하게 만든 것처럼, 유다와 예루살렘 사람들을 하나님께 불성실하게 만들었다. 너는 너보다 훨씬 나은 사람들인 너의 친형제들, 곧 너의 아버지의 아들들까지 죽였다.

pt.L: mas andaste no caminho dos reis de Israel, e fizeste Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém se prostituírem, como a prostituição da casa de Acabe, e também mataste os teus irmãos, a casa do teu pai, que eram melhores do que tu,
pt.B: mas seguiste o caminho dos reis de Israel e levaste Judá e os moradores de Jerusalém a se prostituírem, como fez a casa de Acabe, e ainda mataste os teus irmãos, a própria família do teu pai, homens melhores do que tu,
pt.R: Em vez disso, viveste como os reis de Israel viveram. Levaste Judá e o povo de Jerusalém a serem infiéis a Deus, assim como a família de Acabe levou Israel a ser infiel. Chegaste a matar os teus próprios irmãos, os filhos do teu pai, que eram homens melhores do que tu.

am.L: ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄድህ፤ የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳመነዘረ ይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን ነዋሪዎች እንዲያመነዝሩ አደረግህ፤ ደግሞም ከአንተ የሚሻሉትን ወንድሞችህን፣ የአባትህን ቤት፣ ገደልህ፤
am.B: ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄድህ፤ የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገው ይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን ሕዝብ እንዲያመነዝሩ አደረግህ፤ ደግሞም ከአንተ የሚሻሉትን ወንድሞችህን፣ የገዛ አባትህን ቤተሰብ ገደልህ፤
am.R: ይልቁንም የእስራኤል ነገሥታት እንደ ኖሩ ኖርህ። የአክዓብ ቤተሰብ እስራኤልን ለእግዚአብሔር ታማኝ እንዳይሆኑ እንዳደረገ፣ አንተም ይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን ሕዝብ ለእግዚአብሔር ታማኝ እንዳይሆኑ አደረግህ። ከአንተ የተሻሉ ሰዎች የነበሩትን የአባትህን ልጆች፣ የገዛ ወንድሞችህን እንኳ ገደልህ።

hi.L: बल्कि इस्राएल के राजाओं के मार्ग पर चले हो, और तुमने यहूदा से और यरूशलेम के निवासियों से वैसा ही व्यभिचार करवाया है जैसा अहाब के घराने ने करवाया, और तुमने अपने भाइयों को भी, अपने पिता के घराने को, जो तुमसे अच्छे थे, मार डाला है,
hi.B: बल्कि इस्राएल के राजाओं के मार्ग पर चले हो, और तुमने यहूदा और यरूशलेम के लोगों से व्यभिचार करवाया है, जैसा अहाब के घराने ने किया था। तुमने अपने भाइयों को भी, अपने ही पिता के परिवार को, जो तुमसे अच्छे पुरुष थे, मार डाला है,
hi.R: इसके बदले तुम वैसे जीए हो जैसे इस्राएल के राजा जीए। तुमने यहूदा और यरूशलेम के लोगों को परमेश्वर से विश्वासघात करने में लगाया है, ठीक जैसे अहाब के परिवार ने इस्राएल को लगाया था। तुमने अपने ही भाइयों को, अपने पिता के बेटों को, मार डाला है, जो तुमसे अच्छे पुरुष थे।

ru.L: а ходил путём царей Израиля, и ввёл в блуд Иуду и жителей Иерусалима, как блудил дом Ахава, и также братьев твоих, дом твоего отца, лучших тебя, ты убил, —
ru.B: а последовал путём царей Израиля и вовлёк Иуду и жителей Иерусалима в блуд, как это сделал дом Ахава. Ты убил и своих братьев, семью своего отца, людей лучше тебя.
ru.R: Вместо этого ты жил так, как жили цари Израиля. Ты сделал так, что Иуда и жители Иерусалима стали неверны Богу, как семья Ахава сделала неверным Израиль. Ты даже убил своих родных братьев, сыновей своего отца, которые были лучше тебя.

uk.L: а ходив дорогою царів Ізраїля, і довів Юду і мешканців Єрусалиму до розпусти, як розпуста дому Ахава, і також убив своїх братів, дім свого батька, які були кращі за тебе,
uk.B: а ходив дорогою царів Ізраїля і довів Юду і людей Єрусалиму до розпусти, як зробив дім Ахава, і ще й убив своїх братів, родину свого власного батька, людей, кращих за тебе,
uk.R: Натомість ти жив так, як жили царі Ізраїлю. Ти довів Юду і людей Єрусалиму до невірності Богові, саме як Ахавова родина довела Ізраїль до невірності. Ти навіть убив своїх власних братів, синів свого батька, які були кращими людьми, ніж ти.

decisions.choice: caused them to prostitute themselves: led them to worship other gods
decisions.reason: As in verse 11.

decisions.choice: the prostituting of the house of Ahab: the worship of Baal
decisions.reason: Ahab and Jezebel led Israel to worship Baal and Asherah (1 Kings 16:31-33; 21:25-26). Jehoram brought the same into Judah.

decisions.choice: your brothers, your father's house: the brothers are the father's family
decisions.reason: "Your father's house" stands beside "your brothers" and names the same people: the sons of Jehoshaphat killed in verse 4. They were "better" than Jehoram in that they were more righteous than he was.

decisions.choice: men better than you (Balanced); better men than you (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "men" for the plural adjective "the good ones", since the brothers are meant.

decisions.choice: led Israel to be unfaithful
decisions.reason: Readable says what the house of Ahab did, to make the comparison clear.

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה נֹגֵ֛ף מַגֵּפָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בְּעַמֶּ֑ךָ וּבְבָנֶ֥יךָ וּבְנָשֶׁ֖יךָ וּבְכָל־רְכוּשֶֽׁךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: look, Yahweh [is] striking a blow great on your people and on your sons and on your wives and on all your possessions,

en.L: look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is about to strike a great blow on your people and on your sons and on your wives and on all your possessions,
en.B: so now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is going to bring a heavy blow on your people, on your sons and your wives, and on all that you own,
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is going to send a terrible disaster on your people, your sons, your wives and everything you own.

es.L: he aquí que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a herir con un gran golpe a tu pueblo, y a tus hijos, y a tus mujeres, y todos tus bienes,
es.B: por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a descargar un duro golpe sobre tu pueblo, sobre tus hijos y tus mujeres, y sobre todo lo que tienes,
es.R: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} va a enviar una terrible desgracia sobre tu pueblo, tus hijos, tus mujeres y todo lo que tienes.

fr.L: voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va frapper d’un grand coup ton peuple, et tes fils, et tes femmes, et tous tes biens,
fr.B: c’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va frapper durement ton peuple, tes fils et tes femmes, et tout ce que tu possèdes,
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} va envoyer un terrible malheur sur ton peuple, sur tes fils, sur tes femmes et sur tout ce que tu possèdes.

sw.L: tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapiga pigo kubwa juu ya watu wako na juu ya wana wako na juu ya wake zako na juu ya mali yako yote,
sw.B: basi sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataleta pigo zito juu ya watu wako, juu ya wana wako na wake zako, na juu ya vyote ulivyo navyo,
sw.R: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataleta msiba mkubwa juu ya watu wako, wana wako, wake zako na kila kitu ulicho nacho.

vi.L: kìa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sắp giáng một tai vạ lớn trên dân ngươi, trên các con trai ngươi, trên các vợ ngươi và trên mọi tài sản của ngươi;
vi.B: nên bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng một tai vạ nặng nề trên dân ngươi, trên các con trai và các vợ ngươi, cùng mọi của cải ngươi có;
vi.R: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng một tai họa khủng khiếp trên dân ngươi, các con trai ngươi, các vợ ngươi và mọi thứ ngươi có.

ko.L: 보아라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너의 백성과 너의 아들들과 너의 아내들과 너의 모든 재산을 큰 재앙으로 치려 한다.
ko.B: 그러므로 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너의 백성과 너의 아들들과 아내들과 너의 모든 재산에 무서운 재앙을 내리려고 한다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너의 백성과 아들들과 아내들과 네가 가진 모든 것에 끔찍한 재앙을 내릴 것이다.

pt.L: eis que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai ferir com um grande golpe o teu povo, e os teus filhos, e as tuas mulheres, e todos os teus bens,
pt.B: por isso agora {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai trazer um golpe pesado sobre o teu povo, sobre os teus filhos e as tuas mulheres, e sobre tudo o que possuis,
pt.R: Por isso {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai mandar uma terrível desgraça sobre o teu povo, os teus filhos, as tuas mulheres e tudo o que tens.

am.L: እነሆ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝብህም፣ በልጆችህም፣ በሚስቶችህም፣ በንብረትህም ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ መቅሠፍት ሊያመጣ ነው፤
am.B: ስለዚህ አሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝብህ፣ በልጆችህና በሚስቶችህ፣ በንብረትህም ሁሉ ላይ ከባድ መቅሠፍት ያመጣል፤
am.R: ስለዚህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝብህ፣ በልጆችህ፣ በሚስቶችህና ባለህ ነገር ሁሉ ላይ አስከፊ መቅሠፍት ይልካል።

hi.L: देखो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारी प्रजा पर, और तुम्हारे पुत्रों पर, और तुम्हारी पत्नियों पर, और तुम्हारी सारी संपत्ति पर एक बड़ी मार मारने पर हैं,
hi.B: इसलिए अब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारी प्रजा पर, तुम्हारे पुत्रों और तुम्हारी पत्नियों पर, और तुम्हारी सारी संपत्ति पर भारी मार लानेवाले हैं,

decisions.choice: look ... is about to strike: the result of what Jehoram has done
decisions.reason: After the charge ("because ...", verses 12-13) comes the sentence. "Look" with the participle announces something about to happen.

decisions.choice: a great blow: a disaster sent by Yahweh
decisions.reason: The word can mean a plague, but it is used of any blow Yahweh strikes, including defeat in war (1 Samuel 4:17). Verses 16-17 tell how it fell: raiders carried off the king's goods, sons and wives.

decisions.choice: so now (Balanced); So (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the link between the charge and the sentence with "so" in place of "look".

decisions.choice: a terrible disaster
decisions.reason: Readable says "disaster", which covers both the raid and the loss it brings (m2).

decisions.choice: "주가 ... 치려 한다", without -시-
decisions.reason: These are Yahweh's own words in the letter, and God names himself without the honorific, as in the oracles of Kings.

decisions.choice: "a great blow" is "ታላቅ መቅሠፍት" (Literal), "ከባድ መቅሠፍት" (Balanced), "አስከፊ መቅሠፍት" (Readable).
decisions.reason: The Hebrew noun names a blow sent by God, the word used of the plagues; "መቅሠፍት" is the Pentateuch's word for them.

decisions.choice: a disease of the bowels
decisions.reason: The bowels are the intestines and inner organs. The disease cannot be named with certainty; it was long and painful, and ended with the bowels coming out (verse 19).

decisions.choice: days upon days: over a long time, day after day
alternatives: after some time (the bowels came out after a long illness)
decisions.reason: The phrase means that the illness would go on and grow worse over time. Verse 19 says it lasted two years.

decisions.choice: and you: judgment on the king himself
decisions.reason: After the blow on his household (verse 14), the sentence turns to Jehoram himself, with an emphatic "you". The letter ends here; verses 16-19 tell how both parts came true.

decisions.choice: you yourself
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "you yourself" to keep the stress of the Hebrew pronoun (m3).

decisions.choice: "intestins" (Readable); "entrailles" (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word for the organ; "entrailles" is the traditional word at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: as entranhas (L, B); os intestinos (R)
decisions.reason: "Entranhas" names the inner organs (m1) in the ordinary written word; Readable says "intestinos", the plain everyday word, as in verses 18-19.

decisions.choice: stirred up the spirit: moved them to act
decisions.reason: To stir up someone's spirit is to move him to do something, as Yahweh stirred up the spirit of the king of Assyria (1 Chronicles 5:26) and of Cyrus (36:22). Here Yahweh uses foreign peoples to carry out the blow of verse 14.

decisions.choice: the Arabs who were beside the Cushites
decisions.reason: "At the hand of" means "next to". These Cushites were probably a people living south of Judah, near Gerar, like Zerah's army in 14:8-14, rather than the Cush of the upper Nile. The Philistines and Arabs had brought gifts to Jehoshaphat (17:11); now they turn against his son.

decisions.choice: stirred up the Philistines (Balanced); made ... want to attack (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced folds "the spirit of" into the verb, since stirring up a people means stirring up their will. Readable says what they were stirred up to do.

decisions.choice: "los árabes"; "los cusitas"
decisions.reason: "Cusitas" keeps the name of Cush as the English does, without deciding which land is meant (m2).

decisions.choice: "les Koushites"
decisions.reason: The people of Koush, as "Tirhaqa roi de Koush" in French 2 Kings 19:9; "Éthiopiens" would point to the modern country.

decisions.choice: "người Cút"
decisions.reason: The people of Cush, named as in the 2 Kings drafts ("Tiệt-ha-ca vua Cút"); "Ê-thi-ô-pi" would name a modern country.

decisions.choice: "마음을 일깨워" for "stirred up the spirit"
decisions.reason: Korean "영" would suggest the Spirit of God; "마음" gives the people's will that Yahweh moved (m1).

decisions.choice: despertou ... o espírito (L); incitou (B); os cuxitas
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of stirring up the spirit (m1); Balanced folds it into the verb, as the English does. The people are "os cuxitas", from Cush, not "etíopes", since they probably lived south of Judah (m2).

decisions.choice: the Arabs "ዓረቦች" (as Acts 2:11); the Cushites "ኩሻውያን", from "ኩሻዊ" of 2 Samuel 18:21.
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open which Cushites are meant (perhaps a people near Arabia); the name form keeps that open and keeps the Hebrew name, as Genesis "ኩሽ" does.

source.text: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ בִֽיהוּדָה֙ וַיִּבְקָע֔וּהָ וַיִּשְׁבּ֗וּ אֵ֤ת כָּל־הָרְכוּשׁ֙ הַנִּמְצָ֣א לְבֵית־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְגַם־בָּנָ֖יו וְנָשָׁ֑יו וְלֹ֤א נִשְׁאַר־לוֹ֙ בֵּ֔ן כִּ֥י אִם־יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז קְטֹ֥ן בָּנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And they came up against Judah and broke into it, and they carried away all the possessions found in [the] house of the king, and also his sons and his wives; and not was left to him a son except Jehoahaz, [the] youngest of his sons.

en.L: And they came up against Judah and broke into it, and they carried away all the possessions that were found in the king's house, and also his sons and his wives; and no son was left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
en.B: They came up against Judah and broke into it. They took away as plunder all the goods they found in the king's palace, and his sons and wives as well. Not one son was left to him except Jehoahaz, his youngest.
en.R: They attacked Judah and broke through its defenses. They carried away everything of value in the king's palace, and they took his sons and his wives too. The only son left to him was Jehoahaz, the youngest.

es.L: Y subieron contra Judá e irrumpieron en ella, y se llevaron todos los bienes que se hallaron en la casa del rey, y también a sus hijos y a sus mujeres; y no le quedó hijo, sino Joacaz, el menor de sus hijos.
es.B: Subieron contra Judá e irrumpieron en ella. Se llevaron como botín todos los bienes que encontraron en el palacio del rey, y también a sus hijos y a sus mujeres. No le quedó ningún hijo, excepto Joacaz, el menor.
es.R: Atacaron a Judá y rompieron sus defensas. Se llevaron todo lo de valor que había en el palacio del rey, y también se llevaron a sus hijos y a sus mujeres. El único hijo que le quedó fue Joacaz, el menor.

fr.L: Et ils montèrent contre Juda et y firent une brèche, et ils emmenèrent tous les biens qui se trouvaient dans la maison du roi, et aussi ses fils et ses femmes ; et il ne lui resta pas de fils, sauf Joachaz, le plus jeune de ses fils.
fr.B: Ils montèrent contre Juda et y pénétrèrent de force. Ils emportèrent comme butin tous les biens qu’ils trouvèrent dans le palais du roi, et aussi ses fils et ses femmes. Il ne lui resta pas un seul fils, sauf Joachaz, le plus jeune.
fr.R: Ils ont attaqué Juda et ils ont percé ses défenses. Ils ont emporté tout ce qu’il y avait de valeur dans le palais du roi, et ils ont aussi emmené ses fils et ses femmes. Le seul fils qui lui est resté, c’est Joachaz, le plus jeune.

sw.L: Nao wakapanda juu ya Yuda, wakaivunja, wakachukua mali yote iliyoonekana katika nyumba ya mfalme, na pia wanawe na wake zake; wala hakubakiwa na mwana ila Yehoahazi, mdogo wa wanawe.
sw.B: Walipanda kuishambulia Yuda, wakaivunja. Wakachukua nyara mali yote waliyoikuta katika jumba la mfalme, pamoja na wanawe na wake zake. Hakubakiwa na mwana hata mmoja ila Yehoahazi, mdogo wao wote.
sw.R: Walishambulia Yuda, wakavunja ulinzi wake. Wakachukua kila kitu cha thamani katika jumba la mfalme, wakawachukua pia wanawe na wake zake. Mwana pekee aliyebaki kwake alikuwa Yehoahazi, yule mdogo.

vi.L: Họ đi lên đánh Giu-đa, phá vỡ vào trong, và cướp đi mọi tài sản tìm thấy trong cung vua, cả các con trai và các vợ vua nữa; vua không còn lại con trai nào ngoài Giô-a-cha, con út của vua.
vi.B: Họ đi lên đánh Giu-đa và tràn vào xứ. Họ cướp hết mọi của cải tìm thấy trong cung vua, bắt cả các con trai và các vợ vua. Vua không còn lại một con trai nào ngoài Giô-a-cha, con út.
vi.R: Họ tấn công Giu-đa và phá vỡ hàng phòng thủ. Họ lấy đi mọi thứ có giá trị trong cung vua, bắt luôn các con trai và các vợ vua. Người con trai duy nhất còn lại là Giô-a-cha, con út.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 유다로 올라와 그곳을 쳐부수고 들어와, 왕의 집에서 발견된 모든 재물과 그의 아들들과 그의 아내들까지 사로잡아 갔다. 그리고 그의 아들들 가운데 막내 여호아하스 외에는 그에게 아들이 남지 않았다.
ko.B: 그들은 유다로 쳐올라와 그곳을 휩쓸고, 왕궁에서 찾아낸 모든 재물과 왕의 아들들과 아내들까지 약탈해 갔다. 그에게는 막내아들 여호아하스 외에는 아들이 하나도 남지 않았다.
ko.R: 그들은 유다를 공격하여 방어선을 뚫고 들어왔다. 그들은 왕궁에 있던 값진 것을 모두 가져갔고, 왕의 아들들과 아내들도 끌고 갔다. 여호람에게 남은 아들은 막내 여호아하스뿐이었다.

pt.L: E subiram contra Judá e o invadiram, e levaram todos os bens que se acharam na casa do rei, e também os seus filhos e as suas mulheres; e não lhe ficou filho, exceto Jeoacaz, o mais novo dos seus filhos.
pt.B: Eles subiram contra Judá e o invadiram. Levaram como despojo todos os bens que encontraram no palácio do rei, e também os filhos e as mulheres dele. Não lhe sobrou nenhum filho, exceto Jeoacaz, o mais novo.
pt.R: Eles atacaram Judá e romperam as suas defesas. Levaram tudo o que havia de valor no palácio do rei e levaram também os filhos e as mulheres dele. O único filho que sobrou para Jorão foi Jeoacaz, o mais novo.

am.L: ወደ ይሁዳም ወጡ፤ ሰብረውም ገቡባት፤ በንጉሡም ቤት የተገኘውን ንብረት ሁሉ፣ ደግሞም ልጆቹንና ሚስቶቹን ማርከው ወሰዱ፤ ከልጆቹም ከታናሹ ከኢዮአካዝ በቀር ልጅ አልቀረለትም።
am.B: በይሁዳ ላይ ወጥተው ሰብረው ገቡባት። በቤተ መንግሥቱ ያገኙትን ንብረት ሁሉ፣ ልጆቹንና ሚስቶቹንም ደግሞ ማርከው ወሰዱ። ከታናሹ ልጁ ከኢዮአካዝ በቀር አንድም ልጅ አልቀረለትም።
am.R: ይሁዳን ወጉ፤ መከላከያዋንም ሰብረው ገቡ። በንጉሡ ቤተ መንግሥት ያለውን ውድ ነገር ሁሉ ወሰዱ፤ ልጆቹንና ሚስቶቹንም ደግሞ ይዘው ሄዱ። ለኢዮራም የቀረለት ልጅ ታናሹ ኢዮአካዝ ብቻ ነበረ።

hi.L: और वे यहूदा पर चढ़ आए और उसमें घुस पड़े, और राजा के भवन में जो सारी संपत्ति मिली, और उसके पुत्रों और उसकी पत्नियों को भी, बंदी बनाकर ले गए; और उसके सबसे छोटे पुत्र यहोआहाज़ को छोड़ उसका कोई पुत्र न बचा।
hi.B: वे यहूदा पर चढ़ आए और उसमें घुस पड़े। राजमहल में जो कुछ सामान उन्हें मिला, वह सब वे लूटकर ले गए, और उसके पुत्रों और पत्नियों को भी। उसके सबसे छोटे पुत्र यहोआहाज़ को छोड़ उसका एक भी पुत्र न बचा।
hi.R: उन्होंने यहूदा पर हमला किया और उसकी रक्षा को तोड़कर भीतर घुस आए। राजमहल में जो कुछ क़ीमती था, वे सब ले गए, और उसके बेटों और पत्नियों को भी ले गए। उसका केवल एक बेटा बचा, सबसे छोटा, यहोआहाज़।

ru.L: И поднялись они на Иуду, и вторглись в него, и увели всё имущество, найденное в доме царя, и также его сыновей и его жён; и не осталось у него сына, кроме Иоахаза, младшего из его сыновей.
ru.B: Они пошли на Иуду и вторглись в него. Они захватили всё имущество, какое нашли в царском дворце, а также его сыновей и жён. У него не осталось ни одного сына, кроме Иоахаза, самого младшего.
ru.R: Они напали на Иуду и прорвали его оборону. Они унесли всё ценное, что было в царском дворце, и увели его сыновей и жён. У царя остался только один сын — Иоахаз, самый младший.

uk.L: І пішли вони на Юду, і вдерлися в нього, і забрали все майно, що знайшлося в домі царя, а також його синів і його жінок; і не залишилося в нього сина, крім Єгоахаза, наймолодшого з його синів.
uk.B: Вони пішли на Юду і вдерлися в нього. Вони забрали як здобич усе майно, яке знайшли в царському палаці, а також його синів і жінок. У нього не залишилося жодного сина, крім Єгоахаза, наймолодшого.
uk.R: Вони напали на Юду і прорвали його оборону. Вони забрали все цінне в царському палаці і забрали також його синів і жінок. Єдиним сином, що залишився в нього, був Єгоахаз, наймолодший.

decisions.choice: broke into it: broke through Judah's defenses
decisions.reason: The verb means to split or break open, used of breaking through a wall or a line (2 Kings 25:4). The raiders forced their way into the land.

decisions.choice: the king's house: the palace, and perhaps the king's household
decisions.reason: The house of the king is his palace. The raid may not have reached Jerusalem itself: the goods, sons and wives may have been those at the king's residences elsewhere. 22:1 says the raiders killed all the older sons.

decisions.choice: Jehoahaz: the son who reigned as Ahaziah
decisions.reason: 22:1 calls the youngest son Ahaziah, as 2 Kings 8:24 does. Both names are made of the same two parts, "Yahweh" and "has grasped", in the opposite order. It is one person.

decisions.choice: the first part of the letter comes true
decisions.reason: The blow on his people, sons, wives and possessions (verse 14) falls as foretold.

decisions.choice: palace
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "palace" for the king's house.

decisions.choice: "Joacaz"
decisions.reason: The name as this verse gives it, as the English keeps "Jehoahaz"; the meaning decision explains that he reigned as Ocozías (m3). Spanish writes Joacaz for Jehoahaz, as the terms note's table.

decisions.choice: "Joachaz"
decisions.reason: The form French 2 Kings uses for Jehoahaz; this son reigns as Achazia (22:1), and each verse keeps its own name.

decisions.choice: "Giô-a-cha"
decisions.reason: The verse names him Jehoahaz (m3); the name is kept as the Hebrew has it, in the form the 2 Kings drafts use for that name.

decisions.choice: "여호아하스" as the verse names him
decisions.reason: The same king is called Ahaziah in 22:1 (m3); as the terms note sets, each verse keeps its own form of a name.

decisions.choice: Jeoacaz
decisions.reason: Chronicles names the son "Jehoahaz" here and "Ahaziah" in 22:1 (m3); the Portuguese keeps the name the Hebrew has, in the form of the shared list for Kings, "Jeoacaz", as the English keeps "Jehoahaz", and leaves the identification to the meaning note.

decisions.choice: Jehoahaz is "ኢዮአካዝ", the form of the name in 2 Kings 10:35, though he is the king called Ahaziah ("አካዝያስ") in 22:1.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the form Jehoahaz (the same two parts of the name in the other order); the Amharic follows the Hebrew and the meaning decision tells the reader who he is.

decisions.choice: "यहोआहाज़"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has Jehoahaz, the son who reigned as Ahaziah (meaning m3); the Hindi keeps the name the Hebrew has here, as the history-books note does for Uzziah and Azariah.

source.text: וְאַחֲרֵ֖י כָּל־זֹ֑את נְגָפ֨וֹ יְהוָ֧ה׀בְּמֵעָ֛יו לָחֳלִ֖י לְאֵ֥ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And after all this struck him Yahweh in his bowels with a sickness for which there [was] no healing.

en.L: And after all this {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck him in his bowels with a disease for which there [was] no healing.
en.B: After all this {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck him with an incurable disease of the bowels.
en.R: After all this, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck Jehoram with a disease in his bowels that could not be cured.

es.L: Y después de todo esto, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo hirió en sus entrañas con una enfermedad para la cual no [había] curación.
es.B: Después de todo esto, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo hirió con una enfermedad incurable de las entrañas.
es.R: Después de todo esto, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} castigó a Jehoram con una enfermedad en las entrañas que no tenía cura.

fr.L: Et après tout cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le frappa dans ses entrailles d’une maladie pour laquelle [il n’y avait] pas de guérison.
fr.B: Après tout cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le frappa d’une maladie des entrailles incurable.
fr.R: Après tout cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a frappé Yehoram d’une maladie des intestins qu’on ne pouvait pas guérir.

sw.L: Na baada ya hayo yote {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akampiga katika matumbo yake kwa ugonjwa usio na uponyaji.
sw.B: Baada ya hayo yote {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpiga kwa ugonjwa wa matumbo usioponyeka.
sw.R: Baada ya hayo yote, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpiga Yehoramu kwa ugonjwa wa matumbo ambao haukuweza kuponywa.

vi.L: Sau mọi việc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đánh vua trong ruột bằng một căn bệnh không [thể] chữa lành.
vi.B: Sau mọi việc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng trên vua một bệnh trong ruột không thể chữa được.
vi.R: Sau mọi việc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giáng trên Giê-hô-ram một bệnh trong ruột không thể chữa khỏi.

ko.L: 그리고 이 모든 일 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고칠 수 없는 병으로 그의 창자를 치셨다.
ko.B: 이 모든 일 뒤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 쳐서 고칠 수 없는 창자 병에 걸리게 하셨다.
ko.R: 이 모든 일이 있은 뒤에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호람을 치셔서 창자에 고칠 수 없는 병이 들게 하셨다.

pt.L: E depois de tudo isto {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o feriu nas suas entranhas com uma doença para a qual não [havia] cura.
pt.B: Depois de tudo isso, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o feriu com uma doença incurável nas entranhas.
pt.R: Depois de tudo isso, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez Jorão ficar com uma doença nos intestinos que não tinha cura.

am.L: ከዚህም ሁሉ በኋላ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መድኃኒት በሌለው ደዌ አንጀቱን መታው።
am.B: ከዚህ ሁሉ በኋላ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በማይድን የአንጀት በሽታ መታው።
am.R: ከዚህ ሁሉ በኋላ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ኢዮራምን ሊድን በማይችል የአንጀት በሽታ መታው።

hi.L: और इस सब के बाद {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसकी अंतड़ियों में ऐसा रोग लगाया जिसका कोई इलाज न [था]।
hi.B: इस सब के बाद {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसकी अंतड़ियों में एक असाध्य रोग लगा दिया।
hi.R: इस सब के बाद {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने यहोराम की अंतड़ियों में ऐसा रोग लगा दिया जिसका इलाज नहीं हो सकता था।

ru.L: И после всего этого поразил его {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} в его внутренности болезнью, от которой нет исцеления.
ru.B: После всего этого {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поразил его неизлечимой болезнью внутренностей.
ru.R: После всего этого {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поразил Иорама болезнью внутренностей, которую нельзя было вылечить.

uk.L: А після всього цього {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} уразив його в нутрощі хворобою, для якої не [було] ліку.
uk.B: Після всього цього {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} уразив його невиліковною хворобою нутрощів.
uk.R: Після всього цього {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} уразив Єгорама хворобою нутрощів, яку не можна було вилікувати.

decisions.choice: the second part of the letter comes true
decisions.reason: The disease of the bowels foretold in verse 15 now strikes him.

decisions.choice: no healing: no cure
decisions.reason: The word means healing or remedy. The disease was beyond any cure.

decisions.choice: Jehoram
decisions.reason: Readable names Jehoram for "him".

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י לְיָמִ֣ים׀מִיָּמִ֡ים וּכְעֵת֩ צֵ֨את הַקֵּ֜ץ לְיָמִ֣ים שְׁנַ֗יִם יָצְא֤וּ מֵעָיו֙ עִם־חָלְי֔וֹ וַיָּ֖מָת בְּתַחֲלֻאִ֣ים רָעִ֑ים וְלֹא־עָ֨שׂוּ ל֥וֹ עַמּ֛וֹ שְׂרֵפָ֖ה כִּשְׂרֵפַ֥ת אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, at days from days, and at [the] time of [the] going out of the end, at days two [years], came out his bowels with his sickness, and he died in harmful diseases; and not made for him his people a burning like [the] burning of his fathers.

en.L: And it happened in the course of days, and at the time of the coming of the end, after two years, his bowels came out with his disease, and he died in terrible pains. And his people did not make a burning for him like the burning of his fathers.
en.B: In the course of time, at the end of two years, his bowels came out because of his disease, and he died in great pain. His people made no fire in his honor like the fire made for his ancestors.
en.R: As time passed, at the end of two years, his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in terrible pain. His people did not light a fire to honor him, as they had done for the kings before him.

es.L: Y sucedió que, con el correr de los días, al llegar el fin, al cabo de dos años, sus entrañas se le salieron con su enfermedad, y murió con terribles dolores. Y su pueblo no le hizo una hoguera como la hoguera de sus padres.
es.B: Con el paso del tiempo, al cabo de dos años, se le salieron las entrañas a causa de su enfermedad, y murió con grandes dolores. Su pueblo no encendió ninguna hoguera en su honor, como la que se había hecho por sus antepasados.
es.R: Pasó el tiempo, y al cabo de dos años se le salieron las entrañas por causa de la enfermedad, y murió con terribles dolores. Su pueblo no encendió ninguna hoguera para honrarlo, como lo había hecho por los reyes anteriores.

fr.L: Et il arriva, au fil des jours, au moment où vint la fin, au bout de deux ans, que ses entrailles sortirent avec sa maladie, et il mourut dans de terribles souffrances. Et son peuple ne fit pas pour lui de feu comme le feu de ses pères.
fr.B: Avec le temps, au bout de deux ans, ses entrailles sortirent à cause de sa maladie, et il mourut dans de grandes souffrances. Son peuple n’alluma pas de feu en son honneur, comme on l’avait fait pour ses ancêtres.
fr.R: Le temps a passé et, au bout de deux ans, ses intestins sont sortis à cause de la maladie. Il est mort dans de terribles souffrances. Son peuple n’a pas allumé de feu pour l’honorer, comme on l’avait fait pour les rois avant lui.

sw.L: Ikawa siku zilipopita, na wakati wa mwisho ulipofika, baada ya miaka miwili, matumbo yake yakatoka kwa sababu ya ugonjwa wake, akafa katika maumivu makali. Wala watu wake hawakumfanyia moto kama moto wa baba zake.
sw.B: Kadiri muda ulivyopita, mwishoni mwa miaka miwili, matumbo yake yalitoka kwa sababu ya ugonjwa wake, naye akafa katika maumivu makali. Watu wake hawakuwasha moto wa kumheshimu kama ule waliowashia babu zake.
sw.R: Muda ulipopita, mwishoni mwa miaka miwili, matumbo yake yalitoka kwa sababu ya ugonjwa huo, naye akafa kwa maumivu makali. Watu wake hawakuwasha moto ili kumheshimu, kama walivyofanya kwa wafalme waliotangulia.

vi.L: Ngày qua ngày, đến lúc cuối cùng, sau hai năm, ruột vua lòi ra vì bệnh ấy, và vua chết trong những cơn đau khủng khiếp. Dân của vua không đốt lửa cho vua như đã đốt cho tổ phụ vua.
vi.B: Ngày tháng trôi qua, đến cuối năm thứ hai, ruột vua lòi ra vì bệnh ấy, và vua chết trong đau đớn cùng cực. Dân chúng không đốt lửa tôn vinh vua như đã làm cho tổ tiên vua.
vi.R: Thời gian trôi qua, đến cuối năm thứ hai, ruột vua lòi ra vì bệnh ấy, và vua chết trong đau đớn khủng khiếp. Dân chúng không đốt lửa để tôn vinh vua như họ đã làm cho các vua trước.

ko.L: 그리고 날이 가고 날이 [가서], 끝이 이를 때에, 2년이 [되었을] 때에, 그의 병 때문에 그의 창자가 빠져나왔고, 그는 극심한 고통 가운데 죽었다. 그리고 그의 백성은 그의 조상들을 위해 불을 피운 것처럼 그를 위해 불을 피우지 않았다.
ko.B: 시간이 흘러 2년이 끝날 무렵에 그 병 때문에 그의 창자가 빠져나왔고, 그는 심한 고통 속에서 죽었다. 그의 백성은 그의 조상들을 위해 피웠던 것 같은 불을 그를 기리려고 피우지 않았다.
ko.R: 시간이 흘러 2년이 지났을 때에, 그 병 때문에 그의 창자가 빠져나왔고, 그는 끔찍한 고통 속에서 죽었다. 그의 백성은 그를 기리는 불을 피우지 않았다. 그 전의 왕들이 죽었을 때에는 그렇게 했었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, com o passar dos dias, e no tempo da chegada do fim, ao fim de dois anos, [que] as suas entranhas saíram com a sua doença, e ele morreu em dores terríveis. E o seu povo não fez para ele uma queima como a queima dos seus pais.
pt.B: Com o passar do tempo, ao fim de dois anos, as suas entranhas saíram por causa da doença, e ele morreu com dores terríveis. O seu povo não acendeu nenhuma fogueira em sua honra, como tinha feito para os seus antepassados.
pt.R: O tempo foi passando e, no fim de dois anos, os intestinos dele saíram por causa da doença, e ele morreu com dores terríveis. O seu povo não acendeu uma fogueira para honrá-lo, como tinha feito para os reis antes dele.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከዘመን ወደ ዘመን፣ በሁለት ዓመትም ፍጻሜ ጊዜ አንጀቱ ከደዌው ጋር ወጣ፤ በክፉ ሥቃይም ሞተ። ሕዝቡም ለአባቶቹ እንዳቃጠሉት ያለ ቃጠሎ አላቃጠሉለትም።
am.B: ከጊዜ በኋላ፣ ሁለት ዓመት ሲሞላ፣ ከበሽታው የተነሣ አንጀቱ ወጣ፤ በጽኑ ሥቃይም ሞተ። ሕዝቡም ለአባቶቹ እንዳደረጉት ለክብሩ እሳት አላነደዱለትም።
am.R: ጊዜው እያለፈ ሄደ፤ ሁለት ዓመት ሲሞላም ከበሽታው የተነሣ አንጀቱ ወጣ፤ በአሰቃቂ ሕመምም ሞተ። ሕዝቡ ከእርሱ በፊት ለነበሩት ነገሥታት እንዳደረጉት ለክብሩ እሳት አላነደዱለትም።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि दिन पर दिन, और अंत आने के समय, दो वर्ष के बाद, उसके रोग के कारण उसकी अंतड़ियाँ निकल आईं, और वह भयंकर पीड़ाओं में मर गया। और उसकी प्रजा ने उसके लिए वैसी आग नहीं जलाई जैसी उसके पूर्वजों के लिए जलाई थी।
hi.B: समय बीतने पर, दो वर्ष के अंत में, उस रोग के कारण उसकी अंतड़ियाँ निकल आईं, और वह बड़ी पीड़ा में मर गया। उसकी प्रजा ने उसके सम्मान में वैसी आग नहीं जलाई जैसी उसके पूर्वजों के लिए जलाई गई थी।
hi.R: समय बीतता गया, और दो वर्ष के अंत में उस रोग के कारण उसकी अंतड़ियाँ निकल आईं। वह भयंकर पीड़ा में मर गया। उसकी प्रजा ने उसके सम्मान में आग नहीं जलाई, जैसी उन्होंने उससे पहले के राजाओं के लिए जलाई थी।

ru.L: И было, со временем, когда пришёл конец, по прошествии двух лет, вышли его внутренности от его болезни, и он умер в тяжких мучениях. И не сделал для него его народ сожжения, как сожжение для его отцов.
ru.B: Со временем, к концу двух лет, от болезни вышли его внутренности, и он умер в тяжких муках. Народ не развёл в его честь огня, как разводил для его предков.
ru.R: Прошло время, и к концу второго года от болезни у него вышли внутренности. Он умер в страшных мучениях. Народ не развёл костёр в его честь, как делал это для прежних царей.

uk.L: І сталося з плином днів, і в час, коли настав кінець, через два роки, його нутрощі вийшли з його хворобою, і він помер у тяжких муках. І його народ не розпалив для нього вогню, як вогонь його батьків.
uk.B: З плином часу, наприкінці двох років, його нутрощі вийшли через хворобу, і він помер у великих муках. Його народ не розпалив на його честь вогню, як розпалювали для його предків.
uk.R: З часом, наприкінці двох років, його нутрощі вийшли через хворобу, і він помер у страшних муках. Його народ не розпалив вогню на його честь, як робили це для царів перед ним.

decisions.choice: in the course of days ... at the end of two years
decisions.reason: The first phrase means "as time went on"; the second dates the end of his illness two years after it began. The words of verse 15 come true.

decisions.choice: a burning: a great fire in honor of the dead king, as for Asa
decisions.reason: At Asa's burial "they made a very great burning for him" (16:14), with spices. Such a fire honored a king (Jeremiah 34:5); the king's body was not burned. Jehoram was denied it.

decisions.choice: harmful diseases: severe sufferings
decisions.reason: The word for diseases is plural and means painful sicknesses or sufferings; with "harmful" it describes a death in great pain.

decisions.choice: his fathers: the kings before him
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means his royal forefathers.

decisions.choice: fire in his honor (Balanced); light a fire to honor him (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "fire" for "burning" and add that it was to honor him (m2). Readable says "the kings before him" for "his fathers".

decisions.choice: "una hoguera"
decisions.reason: "Hoguera" for the honorary fire made at a king's death, the same word at each level (m2).

decisions.choice: "그를 기리려고 피우는 불" for "a burning"
decisions.reason: The burning honored the dead king and was not a cremation (m2); Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does.

decisions.choice: uma queima (L); uma fogueira em sua honra (B), para honrá-lo (R)
decisions.reason: The burning was a great fire made to honor a dead king, not a cremation (m2); the words are those of Asa's burial in 16:14 in Portuguese: Literal keeps "queima" for the Hebrew noun, and Balanced and Readable say "fogueira" and add that it was to honor him, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "a burning" is "ቃጠሎ … አቃጠሉለት" (Literal) and "ለክብሩ እሳት አነደዱለት" (Balanced, Readable), as Asa's burning in 16:14.
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the burning as a fire of honour, not cremation; Literal keeps the Hebrew noun and verb, as the Amharic of 16:14 does, and the other levels say it was in his honour.

decisions.choice: "आग जलाई", as 16:14
decisions.reason: The burning is a fire in the dead king's honour (meaning m2), worded as for Asa in 16:14.

source.text: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּשְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ הָיָ֣ה בְמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּלֹ֣א חֶמְדָּ֔ה וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֨הוּ֙ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד וְלֹ֖א בְּקִבְר֥וֹת הַמְּלָכִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: A son of thirty and two he was when he became king, and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem; and he went with no regret, and they buried him in [the] city of David, but not in [the] tombs of the kings.

en.L: He was a son of thirty-two when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. And he departed with no regret, and they buried him in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
en.B: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. He departed with no one's regret. They buried him in the City of David, but not in the royal tombs.
en.R: He became king at the age of thirty-two, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eight years. When he died, no one was sorry. He was buried in the City of David, but not in the place where the kings were buried.

es.L: Hijo de treinta y dos [años] era cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó ocho años en Jerusalén; y se fue sin que nadie lo lamentara, y lo sepultaron en la ciudad de David, pero no en los sepulcros de los reyes.
es.B: Tenía treinta y dos años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó ocho años en Jerusalén. Se fue sin que nadie lo lamentara. Lo sepultaron en la ciudad de David, pero no en los sepulcros reales.
es.R: Llegó a ser rey a los treinta y dos años, y gobernó en Jerusalén durante ocho años. Cuando murió, nadie lo lamentó. Lo sepultaron en la ciudad de David, pero no en el lugar donde se sepultaba a los reyes.

fr.L: Il était fils de trente-deux [ans] quand il devint roi, et il régna huit ans à Jérusalem. Et il s’en alla sans être regretté, et on l’enterra dans la cité de David, mais pas dans les tombeaux des rois.
fr.B: Il avait trente-deux ans quand il devint roi, et il régna huit ans à Jérusalem. Il s’en alla sans que personne le regrette. On l’enterra dans la cité de David, mais pas dans les tombeaux royaux.
fr.R: Il avait trente-deux ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant huit ans. Quand il est mort, personne ne l’a regretté. On l’a enterré dans la cité de David, mais pas à l’endroit où les rois étaient enterrés.

sw.L: [Alikuwa] mwana wa miaka thelathini na miwili alipoanza kutawala, akatawala miaka minane huko Yerusalemu. Naye akaondoka bila kutamaniwa, wakamzika katika mji wa Daudi, lakini si katika makaburi ya wafalme.
sw.B: Alikuwa na umri wa miaka thelathini na miwili alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka minane huko Yerusalemu. Aliondoka bila mtu kumsikitikia. Wakamzika katika mji wa Daudi, lakini si katika makaburi ya kifalme.
sw.R: Alianza kutawala akiwa na umri wa miaka thelathini na miwili, naye akatawala Yerusalemu kwa miaka minane. Alipokufa, hakuna mtu aliyehuzunika. Alizikwa katika mji wa Daudi, lakini si mahali walipozikwa wafalme.

vi.L: Vua [được] ba mươi hai tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì tám năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua ra đi chẳng ai luyến tiếc, và người ta chôn vua trong thành Đa-vít, nhưng không phải trong lăng mộ các vua.
vi.B: Vua được ba mươi hai tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì tám năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua qua đời mà không ai thương tiếc. Người ta chôn vua trong thành Đa-vít, nhưng không phải trong lăng mộ hoàng gia.
vi.R: Vua lên ngôi lúc ba mươi hai tuổi và cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem tám năm. Khi vua chết, không ai buồn tiếc. Vua được chôn trong thành Đa-vít, nhưng không phải ở nơi chôn các vua.

ko.L: 그가 왕이 되었을 때에 32세였고, 예루살렘에서 8년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그는 아쉬워하는 이 없이 떠났고, 사람들이 그를 다윗 성에 묻었으나, 왕들의 묘실에 [묻지는] 않았다.
ko.B: 여호람은 32세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 8년 동안 다스렸다. 그가 세상을 떠났을 때 아무도 아쉬워하지 않았다. 사람들은 그를 다윗 성에 묻었으나, 왕실 묘지에 묻지는 않았다.
ko.R: 여호람은 32세에 왕이 되었고, 예루살렘에서 8년 동안 다스렸다. 그가 죽었을 때에 아무도 슬퍼하지 않았다. 그는 다윗 성에 묻혔지만, 왕들이 묻힌 곳에 묻히지는 못했다.

pt.L: [Tinha] trinta e dois anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou oito anos em Jerusalém. E partiu sem que ninguém o lamentasse, e o sepultaram na Cidade de Davi, mas não nos sepulcros dos reis.
pt.B: Ele tinha trinta e dois anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou oito anos em Jerusalém. Morreu sem que ninguém sentisse a sua falta. Foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi, mas não nos túmulos dos reis.
pt.R: Jorão tinha trinta e dois anos quando se tornou rei, e governou oito anos em Jerusalém. Quando ele morreu, ninguém ficou triste. Ele foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi, mas não no lugar onde os reis eram sepultados.

am.L: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ሰው ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ። ያለ ናፍቆትም ሄደ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ በነገሥታቱ መቃብር ግን አይደለም።
am.B: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ ዕድሜው ሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ነበር፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ። ማንም ሳያዝንለት አለፈ። በዳዊት ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ በነገሥታቱ መቃብር ግን አልቀበሩትም።
am.R: ንጉሥ በሆነ ጊዜ ሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመቱ ነበር፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ገዛ። በሞተ ጊዜ ማንም አላዘነለትም። በዳዊት ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ነገሥታቱ በተቀበሩበት ስፍራ ግን አልተቀበረም።

hi.L: जब वह राजा बना तब वह बत्तीस वर्ष का था, और उसने यरूशलेम में आठ वर्ष राज्य किया। और वह बिना किसी के पछतावे के चला गया, और उन्होंने उसे दाऊद के नगर में मिट्टी दी, पर राजाओं की क़ब्रों में नहीं।
hi.B: जब वह राजा बना तब वह बत्तीस वर्ष का था, और उसने यरूशलेम में आठ वर्ष राज्य किया। वह चला गया और किसी ने उसके लिए शोक नहीं किया। उन्होंने उसे दाऊद के नगर में मिट्टी दी, पर राजाओं की क़ब्रों में नहीं।
hi.R: जब वह राजा बना, तब वह बत्तीस वर्ष का था। उसने यरूशलेम में आठ वर्ष तक राज्य किया। जब वह मरा, तो किसी को दुःख नहीं हुआ। उसे दाऊद के नगर में दफ़नाया गया, पर उस जगह नहीं जहाँ राजाओं को दफ़नाया जाता था।

ru.L: Тридцати двух [лет] он был, когда воцарился, и восемь лет он царствовал в Иерусалиме. И ушёл он, никем не сожалеемый, и похоронили его в городе Давида, но не в гробницах царей.
ru.B: Ему было тридцать два года, когда он воцарился, и восемь лет он царствовал в Иерусалиме. Он умер, и никто о нём не пожалел. Его похоронили в городе Давида, но не в царских гробницах.
ru.R: Он стал царём в тридцать два года и восемь лет правил в Иерусалиме. Когда он умер, никто не горевал о нём. Его похоронили в городе Давида, но не там, где хоронили царей.

uk.L: Йому було тридцять два [роки], коли він зацарював, і вісім років він царював у Єрусалимі. І відійшов він, ніким не жалуваний, і поховали його в Місті Давида, але не в гробницях царів.
uk.B: Йому було тридцять два роки, коли він зацарював, і вісім років він царював у Єрусалимі. Він відійшов, і ніхто за ним не жалкував. Його поховали в Місті Давида, але не в царських гробницях.
uk.R: Він став царем у тридцять два роки і правив у Єрусалимі вісім років. Коли він помер, ніхто не жалкував. Його поховали в Місті Давида, але не там, де ховали царів.

decisions.choice: the accession formula of verse 5, repeated
decisions.reason: The verse repeats verse 5 to close Jehoram's reign, as Chronicles sometimes does (27:1, 8).

decisions.choice: he departed with no regret: he died and no one missed him
decisions.reason: "He went" means he died. "Without desire" means no one held him dear or longed for him: no one mourned his death.

decisions.choice: buried in the City of David but not in the tombs of the kings
decisions.reason: Burial apart from the royal tombs was a mark of dishonor, as for Joash (24:25) and Uzziah (26:23). 2 Kings 8:24 says he was buried "with his fathers in the City of David"; Chronicles adds that it was not in the kings' tombs.

decisions.choice: they buried him: his people buried him
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; it means that he was buried, by his people (verse 19).

decisions.choice: departed with no one's regret (Balanced); no one was sorry (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "departed" for "went" and says whose regret is missing; Readable says plainly that he died and no one was sorry.

decisions.choice: "Se fue sin que nadie lo lamentara" (B); "Cuando murió, nadie lo lamentó" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "went" as "se fue" and says whose regret is missing; Readable says plainly that he died (m2).

decisions.choice: the formula of verse 5; partiu sem deixar saudade (L); sem que ninguém sentisse a sua falta (B); ninguém ficou triste (R)
decisions.reason: The accession formula repeats verse 5 at each level (m1), as the Portuguese of 2 Kings 8:17. "Sem deixar saudade" is the Portuguese idiom for a departure no one regrets (m2), close to the Hebrew "without desire"; Balanced says who did not miss him, and Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The Amharic of 2 Kings 8:17 for the first sentence is kept where the Hebrew is the same; the burial differs from 2 Kings 8:24, where Jehoram is buried with his fathers: Chronicles says he departed unmourned and was not laid in the tombs of the kings, and has no closing source formula or successor.
alternatives: the 2 Kings 8:17 for the first sentence Amharic unchanged
decisions.reason: Chronicles retells Kings here. The terms list keeps the parallel's wording word for word where the Hebrew agrees and follows Chronicles' own Hebrew where it differs, so that a reader comparing the two sees only the real differences.
